title: Annual leave
text: Every full-time employee at Thimblewood Instruments receives 27 days of paid annual leave per calendar year. On top of this, the Pellmoor workshop closes for three 'Quiet Days' between Christmas and New Year, which are paid and do not count against annual leave. Part-time staff receive annual leave pro rata to their contracted hours.

title: Carrying leave over
text: Up to 6 unused annual-leave days may be carried into the next calendar year. Carried-over days must be taken by 30 April or they are lost. Unused leave is never exchanged for pay, except in an employee's final salary when they leave the company.

title: Booking leave
text: Leave is requested in the Tidepool HR portal and approved by the employee's team lead. Absences longer than three working days must be requested at least 10 working days in advance; shorter absences need 2 working days' notice.

title: Sick leave
text: If you are ill, tell your team lead before 09:30 on the first day of absence. For up to 5 consecutive working days a self-certification form in the Tidepool HR portal is enough; longer absences need a doctor's note. Thimblewood pays full salary for the first 20 sick days in any rolling 12-month period.

title: Parental leave
text: The primary carer receives 26 weeks of parental leave at full pay and the secondary carer receives 8 weeks at full pay, to be taken within the child's first year. Employees become eligible after 6 months of service.

title: Volunteering and bereavement leave
text: Each employee may take 2 paid volunteering days per year to work with a registered charity. Bereavement leave is 5 paid days after the death of a close family member, and 1 paid day to attend any other funeral.

title: Laptops
text: On their first day, new employees choose either a 14-inch Linux laptop or a 14-inch macOS laptop. Laptops are refreshed every 4 years, or sooner if the IT desk certifies a fault that cannot be repaired.

title: Home-office allowance
text: Employees who work from home at least two days a week can claim a one-off home-office allowance of EUR 450 for a desk, a chair or lighting. Receipts must be uploaded within 60 days of purchase. The allowance can be claimed again after 5 years.

title: Monitors and peripherals
text: Each employee may order one external monitor of up to 27 inches, plus a keyboard and mouse of their choice from the approved catalogue. Noise-cancelling headsets are provided to everyone in a customer-facing role.

title: Lost or damaged equipment
text: Lost or stolen equipment must be reported to the IT desk within 24 hours through the #it-desk channel. The company covers the first accidental-damage claim per device; a second claim on the same device within 12 months costs the employee a EUR 75 excess.

title: Returning equipment
text: When leaving Thimblewood, employees return all company equipment on or before their final working day; the IT desk arranges a courier for remote staff. A departing employee may buy their laptop at its depreciated value if it is more than 3 years old.

title: Workshop tools
text: The calibration tools in the Pellmoor workshop, including the torque drivers, the pressure bench and the reference barometers, may only be used after completing the two-hour Workshop Safety induction. Workshop tools must never be taken off site.

title: Booking business travel
text: All business travel is booked through the Driftwood travel desk, at least 14 days before departure where possible. Any booking made fewer than 3 days before departure needs approval from a director.

title: Trains and flights
text: Rail is required for any journey that takes under 5 hours door to door. Flights are booked in economy class, except flights longer than 7 hours, which may be booked in premium economy. Business class is never reimbursed.

title: Hotels
text: Hotel rooms are capped at EUR 160 per night in most cities and EUR 230 per night in capital cities. Employees who stay with friends or family instead may claim a flat EUR 40 hospitality allowance per night.

title: Meals while travelling
text: The daily meal allowance on business trips is EUR 55, covering breakfast, lunch and dinner. Alcohol is not reimbursed. Dinners with customers are paid on the company card and do not count against the daily allowance.

title: Expense claims
text: Expense claims are submitted in the Tidepool HR portal within 30 days of the end of a trip, with a photo of every receipt. Approved claims are paid in the next monthly payroll run. Claims older than 90 days are not reimbursed.

title: Travel insurance and safety
text: Thimblewood's group travel insurance covers every business trip, plus up to 3 personal days added to the end of a business trip. Before travelling outside the European Union, employees must register the trip with the Driftwood travel desk so they can be reached in an emergency.

title: Passwords
text: Passwords for company accounts must be at least 14 characters long and must not be reused across services. All passwords are stored in the company password manager, and passwords are never shared over chat or email.

title: Two-factor authentication
text: A hardware security key is mandatory as the second factor for email, the Tidepool HR portal and the source-code server. Every employee receives two hardware keys and must keep the spare key somewhere other than their laptop bag.

title: Visitors and clean desks
text: Visitors to the Pellmoor workshop sign in at reception, wear a red lanyard and are escorted at all times. Screens must be locked whenever you leave your desk, and printed customer documents are shredded at the end of each day.

title: Phishing and security incidents
text: Suspicious emails are reported with the 'Report phish' button in the mail app. Any suspected security incident, including a compromised account or a lost hardware key, must be reported to the security team within 1 hour by calling the security hotline.

title: Data classification
text: Information is classified as Public, Internal, Confidential or Restricted. Customer calibration records are Confidential: they may only be kept in the records system and never on personal devices or USB drives.

title: Personal devices and software
text: Personal phones may access company email only through the managed mail app. Software that is not in the approved catalogue must be requested from the IT desk, which aims to reply within 3 working days.

title: Pension
text: Thimblewood pays a pension contribution equal to 7% of salary for every employee who contributes at least 4% of their own salary. Employees are enrolled automatically when their 3-month probation period ends and may opt out at any time.

title: Health and dental cover
text: Private health insurance covers each employee and their children under 21. Dental cover includes two check-ups and two hygienist cleanings per year.

title: Learning budget
text: Each employee has an annual learning budget of EUR 1,200 for courses, books and conferences, and may use up to 5 working days per year as paid study leave. Unused budget does not roll over to the next year.

title: Cycling and active commuting
text: Through the cycle-to-work scheme, employees can lease a bicycle worth up to EUR 2,500 by salary sacrifice over 24 months. Anyone who commutes by bike or on foot at least 3 days a week receives a EUR 30 'active commute' bonus every month.

title: Wellbeing
text: The employee assistance programme offers every employee 6 free, confidential counselling sessions per year. The Pellmoor office has a quiet room that can be booked for up to one hour at a time.

title: Sabbaticals and anniversaries
text: After 5 years of service, employees may take a paid 4-week sabbatical, once in every 5-year period. On each 10-year work anniversary, employees receive a hand-made Thimblewood barometer engraved with their name.
